angleRead.name: Hal Richmond
angleRead.text: I'm sitting with the C111 line card, looking at the numbers for Mark Aitken and the rest of the crew. Aitken's got thirty-three home runs and a Gold Glove on his resume, but the off-season is where the real story hides. Mike Paulson is staring down a board of decisions, and I want to see where the continuity snaps. I'm tracing the line from the seven championships we've seen in this era back to the raw stats of guys like Desmond Morton and Frank Reyna. It's not about the money; it's about who stays and who becomes a ghost in the archive.
